ayahs.arabicText: الٓرٰ١۫ كِتٰبٌ اُحْكِمَتْ اٰیٰتُهٗ ثُمَّ فُصِّلَتْ مِنْ لَّدُنْ حَكِیْمٍ خَبِیْرٍۙ
ayahs.translation: Alif. Lam. Ra. This is a Divine Command whose contents have been made firm and set forth in detail from One Who is All-Wise, All-Aware

ayahs.arabicText: اَلَّا تَعْبُدُوْۤا اِلَّا اللّٰهَ١ؕ اِنَّنِیْ لَكُمْ مِّنْهُ نَذِیْرٌ وَّ بَشِیْرٌۙ
ayahs.translation: that you may worship none but Allah. Verily, I have come to you as a warner and a bearer of good news from Him

ayahs.arabicText: وَّ اَنِ اسْتَغْفِرُوْا رَبَّكُمْ ثُمَّ تُوْبُوْۤا اِلَیْهِ یُمَتِّعْكُمْ مَّتَاعًا حَسَنًا اِلٰۤى اَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّى وَّ یُؤْتِ كُلَّ ذِیْ فَضْلٍ فَضْلَهٗ١ؕ وَ اِنْ تَوَلَّوْا فَاِنِّیْۤ اَخَافُ عَلَیْكُمْ عَذَابَ یَوْمٍ كَبِیْرٍ
ayahs.translation: that you may seek forgiveness of your Lord and turn to Him in repentance whereupon He will grant you a fair enjoyment of life until an appointed term, and will bestow favour on everyone who merits favour. But should you turn away (from the truth), I fear for you the chastisement of an Awesome Day.

ayahs.arabicText: اِلَى اللّٰهِ مَرْجِعُكُمْ١ۚ وَ هُوَ عَلٰى كُلِّ شَیْءٍ قَدِیْرٌ
ayahs.translation: Unto Allah is your return, and He has power to do everything.

ayahs.arabicText: اَلَاۤ اِنَّهُمْ یَثْنُوْنَ صُدُوْرَهُمْ لِیَسْتَخْفُوْا مِنْهُ١ؕ اَلَا حِیْنَ یَسْتَغْشُوْنَ ثِیَابَهُمْ١ۙ یَعْلَمُ مَا یُسِرُّوْنَ وَ مَا یُعْلِنُوْنَ١ۚ اِنَّهٗ عَلِیْمٌۢ بِذَاتِ الصُّدُوْرِ
ayahs.translation: Lo! They fold up their breasts that they may conceal themselves from Him. Surely when they cover themselves up with their garments Allah knows well what they cover and what they reveal. Indeed He even knows the secrets hidden in the breasts.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ مَا مِنْ دَآبَّةٍ فِی الْاَرْضِ اِلَّا عَلَى اللّٰهِ رِزْقُهَا وَ یَعْلَمُ مُسْتَقَرَّهَا وَ مُسْتَوْدَعَهَا١ؕ كُلٌّ فِیْ كِتٰبٍ مُّبِیْنٍ
ayahs.translation: There is not a single moving creature on the earth but Allah is responsible for providing its sustenance. He knows where it dwells and where it will permanently rest. All this is recorded in a clear Book.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ هُوَ الَّذِیْ خَلَقَ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَ الْاَرْضَ فِیْ سِتَّةِ اَیَّامٍ وَّ كَانَ عَرْشُهٗ عَلَى الْمَآءِ لِیَبْلُوَكُمْ اَیُّكُمْ اَحْسَنُ عَمَلًا١ؕ وَ لَئِنْ قُلْتَ اِنَّكُمْ مَّبْعُوْثُوْنَ مِنْۢ بَعْدِ الْمَوْتِ لَیَقُوْلَنَّ الَّذِیْنَ كَفَرُوْۤا اِنْ هٰذَاۤ اِلَّا سِحْرٌ مُّبِیْنٌ
ayahs.translation: And He it is Who created the heavens and the earth in six days - and [before that] His Throne was upon the water that He may test you, who of you is better in conduct If you were to say (O Muhammad): 'All of you will surely be raised after death', then those who disbelieve will certainly say: 'This is nothing but plain sorcery.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ لَئِنْ اَخَّرْنَا عَنْهُمُ الْعَذَابَ اِلٰۤى اُمَّةٍ مَّعْدُوْدَةٍ لَّیَقُوْلُنَّ مَا یَحْبِسُهٗ١ؕ اَلَا یَوْمَ یَاْتِیْهِمْ لَیْسَ مَصْرُوْفًا عَنْهُمْ وَ حَاقَ بِهِمْ مَّا كَانُوْا بِهٖ یَسْتَهْزِءُوْنَ۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: And were We to put off the chastisement from them for a determined period, they will cry out: 'What withholds Him from chastising?' Surely when the day of the chastisement will come, nothing will avert it and the chastisement which they had ridiculed shall encompass them.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ لَئِنْ اَذَقْنَا الْاِنْسَانَ مِنَّا رَحْمَةً ثُمَّ نَزَعْنٰهَا مِنْهُ١ۚ اِنَّهٗ لَیَئُوْسٌ كَفُوْرٌ
ayahs.translation: If We ever favour man with Our Mercy, and then take it away from him, he becomes utterly desperate, totally ungrateful.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ لَئِنْ اَذَقْنٰهُ نَعْمَآءَ بَعْدَ ضَرَّآءَ مَسَّتْهُ لَیَقُوْلَنَّ ذَهَبَ السَّیِّاٰتُ عَنِّیْ١ؕ اِنَّهٗ لَفَرِحٌ فَخُوْرٌۙ
ayahs.translation: And if We let him taste favour after harm has touched him, he says: 'All my ills are gone', and he suddenly becomes exultant and boastful,

ayahs.arabicText: اِلَّا الَّذِیْنَ صَبَرُوْا وَ عَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ١ؕ اُولٰٓئِكَ لَهُمْ مَّغْفِرَةٌ وَّ اَجْرٌ كَبِیْرٌ
ayahs.translation: except those who are patient and act righteously. Such shall have Allah's forgiveness and a great reward.

ayahs.arabicText: فَلَعَلَّكَ تَارِكٌۢ بَعْضَ مَا یُوْحٰۤى اِلَیْكَ وَ ضَآئِقٌۢ بِهٖ صَدْرُكَ اَنْ یَّقُوْلُوْا لَوْ لَاۤ اُنْزِلَ عَلَیْهِ كَنْزٌ اَوْ جَآءَ مَعَهٗ مَلَكٌ١ؕ اِنَّمَاۤ اَنْتَ نَذِیْرٌ١ؕ وَ اللّٰهُ عَلٰى كُلِّ شَیْءٍ وَّكِیْلٌؕ
ayahs.translation: (O Messenger!) Let it not happen that you omit (to expound) a portion of what was revealed to you. And do not be distressed that they will say: 'Why was a treasure not bestowed upon him?' or 'Why did no angel accompany him?' For you are merely a warner, whereas Allah has control over everything.

ayahs.arabicText: اَمْ یَقُوْلُوْنَ افْتَرٰىهُ١ؕ قُلْ فَاْتُوْا بِعَشْرِ سُوَرٍ مِّثْلِهٖ مُفْتَرَیٰتٍ وَّ ادْعُوْا مَنِ اسْتَطَعْتُمْ مِّنْ دُوْنِ اللّٰهِ اِنْ كُنْتُمْ صٰدِقِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: Do they say: 'He has invented this Book himself?' Say: 'If that is so, bring ten surahs the like of it of your composition, and call upon all (the deities) you can other than Allah to your help. Do so if you are truthful.'

ayahs.arabicText: فَاِلَّمْ یَسْتَجِیْبُوْا لَكُمْ فَاعْلَمُوْۤا اَنَّمَاۤ اُنْزِلَ بِعِلْمِ اللّٰهِ وَ اَنْ لَّاۤ اِلٰهَ اِلَّا هُوَ١ۚ فَهَلْ اَنْتُمْ مُّسْلِمُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Then if (your deities) do not respond to your call for help then feel assured that this Book was revealed with the knowledge of Allah, and that there is no true god but Him. Will you, then, surrender (to this truth)?

ayahs.arabicText: مَنْ كَانَ یُرِیْدُ الْحَیٰوةَ الدُّنْیَا وَ زِیْنَتَهَا نُوَفِّ اِلَیْهِمْ اَعْمَالَهُمْ فِیْهَا وَ هُمْ فِیْهَا لَا یُبْخَسُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Those who seek merely the present world and its adornment. We fully recompense them for their work in this world, and they are made to suffer no diminution in it concerning what is their due.

ayahs.arabicText: اُولٰٓئِكَ الَّذِیْنَ لَیْسَ لَهُمْ فِی الْاٰخِرَةِ اِلَّا النَّارُ١ۖ٘ وَ حَبِطَ مَا صَنَعُوْا فِیْهَا وَ بٰطِلٌ مَّا كَانُوْا یَعْمَلُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: They are the ones who shall have nothing in the Hereafter except Fire. (There they shall come to know) that their deeds in the world have come to naught; and that whatever they have done is absolutely useless.

ayahs.arabicText: اَفَمَنْ كَانَ عَلٰى بَیِّنَةٍ مِّنْ رَّبِّهٖ وَ یَتْلُوْهُ شَاهِدٌ مِّنْهُ وَ مِنْ قَبْلِهٖ كِتٰبُ مُوْسٰۤى اِمَامًا وَّ رَحْمَةً١ؕ اُولٰٓئِكَ یُؤْمِنُوْنَ بِهٖ١ؕ وَ مَنْ یَّكْفُرْ بِهٖ مِنَ الْاَحْزَابِ فَالنَّارُ مَوْعِدُهٗ١ۚ فَلَا تَكُ فِیْ مِرْیَةٍ مِّنْهُ١ۗ اِنَّهُ الْحَقُّ مِنْ رَّبِّكَ وَ لٰكِنَّ اَكْثَرَ النَّاسِ لَا یُؤْمِنُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Can it happen that he who takes his stand on a clear evidence from his Lord, subsequently followed by a witness from Him (in his support), and prior to that the Book of Moses was revealed as a guide and a mercy, (would even he deny the truth in the manner of those who adore the life of this world)? Rather, such men are bound to believe in it. The Fire shall be the promised resort of the groups that disbelieve. So be in no doubt about it for this indeed is the truth from your Lord although most people do not believe.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ مَنْ اَظْلَمُ مِمَّنِ افْتَرٰى عَلَى اللّٰهِ كَذِبًا١ؕ اُولٰٓئِكَ یُعْرَضُوْنَ عَلٰى رَبِّهِمْ وَ یَقُوْلُ الْاَشْهَادُ هٰۤؤُلَآءِ الَّذِیْنَ كَذَبُوْا عَلٰى رَبِّهِمْ١ۚ اَلَا لَعْنَةُ اللّٰهِ عَلَى الظّٰلِمِیْنَۙ
ayahs.translation: And who is a greater wrong-doer than he who invents a lie against Allah? Such men will be set forth before their Lord and witnesses will say: 'These are the ones who lied against their Lord. Lo! Allah's curse be upon the wrong-doers;

ayahs.arabicText: الَّذِیْنَ یَصُدُّوْنَ عَنْ سَبِیْلِ اللّٰهِ وَ یَبْغُوْنَهَا عِوَجًا١ؕ وَ هُمْ بِالْاٰخِرَةِ هُمْ كٰفِرُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: upon those who bar people from the way of Allah, and seek in it crookedness, and disbelieve in the Hereafter.

ayahs.arabicText: اُولٰٓئِكَ لَمْ یَكُوْنُوْا مُعْجِزِیْنَ فِی الْاَرْضِ وَ مَا كَانَ لَهُمْ مِّنْ دُوْنِ اللّٰهِ مِنْ اَوْلِیَآءَ١ۘ یُضٰعَفُ لَهُمُ الْعَذَابُ١ؕ مَا كَانُوْا یَسْتَطِیْعُوْنَ السَّمْعَ وَ مَا كَانُوْا یُبْصِرُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: They had no power to frustrate Allah's design in the earth, nor did they have any protectors against Allah. Their chastisement will be doubled. They were unable to hear, nor could they see.

ayahs.arabicText: اُولٰٓئِكَ الَّذِیْنَ خَسِرُوْۤا اَنْفُسَهُمْ وَ ضَلَّ عَنْهُمْ مَّا كَانُوْا یَفْتَرُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: They caused utter loss to themselves, and all that they had invented failed them.

ayahs.arabicText: لَا جَرَمَ اَنَّهُمْ فِی الْاٰخِرَةِ هُمُ الْاَخْسَرُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Doubtlessly, they shall be the greatest losers in the Hereafter.

ayahs.arabicText: اِنَّ الَّذِیْنَ اٰمَنُوْا وَ عَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ وَ اَخْبَتُوْۤا اِلٰى رَبِّهِمْ١ۙ اُولٰٓئِكَ اَصْحٰبُ الْجَنَّةِ١ۚ هُمْ فِیْهَا خٰلِدُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: As for those who believed and acted righteously and dedicated themselves totally to their Lord -they are the people of Paradise, and there they shall abide forever.

ayahs.arabicText: مَثَلُ الْفَرِیْقَیْنِ كَالْاَعْمٰى وَ الْاَصَمِّ وَ الْبَصِیْرِ وَ السَّمِیْعِ١ؕ هَلْ یَسْتَوِیٰنِ مَثَلًا١ؕ اَفَلَا تَذَكَّرُوْنَ۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: The example of the two parties is that one is blind and deaf, and the other capable of seeing and hearing. Can the two be equals? Will you, then, not heed?'

ayahs.arabicText: وَ لَقَدْ اَرْسَلْنَا نُوْحًا اِلٰى قَوْمِهٖۤ١٘ اِنِّیْ لَكُمْ نَذِیْرٌ مُّبِیْنٌۙ
ayahs.translation: (Such were the circumstances) when We sent forth Noah to his people. (He said): 'I have been sent to you to warn you plainly

ayahs.arabicText: اَنْ لَّا تَعْبُدُوْۤا اِلَّا اللّٰهَ١ؕ اِنِّیْۤ اَخَافُ عَلَیْكُمْ عَذَابَ یَوْمٍ اَلِیْمٍ
ayahs.translation: that you may worship none but Allah or else I fear for you the chastisement of a Grievous Day.

ayahs.arabicText: فَقَالَ الْمَلَاُ الَّذِیْنَ كَفَرُوْا مِنْ قَوْمِهٖ مَا نَرٰىكَ اِلَّا بَشَرًا مِّثْلَنَا وَ مَا نَرٰىكَ اتَّبَعَكَ اِلَّا الَّذِیْنَ هُمْ اَرَاذِلُنَا بَادِیَ الرَّاْیِ١ۚ وَ مَا نَرٰى لَكُمْ عَلَیْنَا مِنْ فَضْلٍۭ بَلْ نَظُنُّكُمْ كٰذِبِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: The notables among Noah's own people, who had refused to follow him, responded: 'We merely consider you a human being like ourselves. Nor do we find among those who follow you except the lowliest of our folk, the men who follow you without any proper reason. We see nothing in you to suggest that you are any better than us. Rather, we believe you to be liars.'

ayahs.arabicText: قَالَ یٰقَوْمِ اَرَءَیْتُمْ اِنْ كُنْتُ عَلٰى بَیِّنَةٍ مِّنْ رَّبِّیْ وَ اٰتٰىنِیْ رَحْمَةً مِّنْ عِنْدِهٖ فَعُمِّیَتْ عَلَیْكُمْ١ؕ اَنُلْزِمُكُمُوْهَا وَ اَنْتُمْ لَهَا كٰرِهُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Noah said: 'My people! If I base myself on a clear evidence from my Lord, and I have also been blessed by His mercy to which you have been blind, how can we force it upon you despite your aversion to it?

ayahs.arabicText: وَ یٰقَوْمِ لَاۤ اَسْئَلُكُمْ عَلَیْهِ مَالًا١ؕ اِنْ اَجْرِیَ اِلَّا عَلَى اللّٰهِ وَ مَاۤ اَنَا بِطَارِدِ الَّذِیْنَ اٰمَنُوْا١ؕ اِنَّهُمْ مُّلٰقُوْا رَبِّهِمْ وَ لٰكِنِّیْۤ اَرٰىكُمْ قَوْمًا تَجْهَلُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: My people! I seek no recompense from you. My recompense is only with Allah. Nor will I drive away those who believe. They are destined to meet their Lord. But I find you to be an ignorant people.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ یٰقَوْمِ مَنْ یَّنْصُرُنِیْ مِنَ اللّٰهِ اِنْ طَرَدْتُّهُمْ١ؕ اَفَلَا تَذَكَّرُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: My people! Were I to drive the men of faith away, who will protect me from (the chastisement of) Allah? Do you not understand even this much?

ayahs.arabicText: وَ لَاۤ اَقُوْلُ لَكُمْ عِنْدِیْ خَزَآئِنُ اللّٰهِ وَ لَاۤ اَعْلَمُ الْغَیْبَ وَ لَاۤ اَقُوْلُ اِنِّیْ مَلَكٌ وَّ لَاۤ اَقُوْلُ لِلَّذِیْنَ تَزْدَرِیْۤ اَعْیُنُكُمْ لَنْ یُّؤْتِیَهُمُ اللّٰهُ خَیْرًا١ؕ اَللّٰهُ اَعْلَمُ بِمَا فِیْۤ اَنْفُسِهِمْ١ۖۚ اِنِّیْۤ اِذًا لَّمِنَ الظّٰلِمِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: I do not say to you that I possess Allah's treasures, nor that I have access to the realm beyond the ken of sense-perception, nor do I claim to be an angel. Nor do I say regarding those whom you look upon with disdain that Allah will not bestow any good upon them. Allah knows best what is in their hearts. Were I to say so I would be one of the wrongdoers.'

ayahs.arabicText: قَالُوْا یٰنُوْحُ قَدْ جٰدَلْتَنَا فَاَكْثَرْتَ جِدَا لَنَا فَاْتِنَا بِمَا تَعِدُنَاۤ اِنْ كُنْتَ مِنَ الصّٰدِقِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: They said: 'O Noah! Surely you have disputed with us and have prolonged your dispute. Now bring upon us the chastisement that you threaten us with; do so, if you are truthful.'

ayahs.arabicText: قَالَ اِنَّمَا یَاْتِیْكُمْ بِهِ اللّٰهُ اِنْ شَآءَ وَ مَاۤ اَنْتُمْ بِمُعْجِزِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: Noah said: 'Only Allah will bring it upon you if He so wills, and you will be utterly unable to frustrate that.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ لَا یَنْفَعُكُمْ نُصْحِیْۤ اِنْ اَرَدْتُّ اَنْ اَنْصَحَ لَكُمْ اِنْ كَانَ اللّٰهُ یُرِیْدُ اَنْ یُّغْوِیَكُمْ١ؕ هُوَ رَبُّكُمْ١۫ وَ اِلَیْهِ تُرْجَعُوْنَؕ
ayahs.translation: If I want to give you good advice that will not profit you if Allah Himself has decided to let you go astray. He is your Lord, and to Him will you be returned.'

ayahs.arabicText: اَمْ یَقُوْلُوْنَ افْتَرٰىهُ١ؕ قُلْ اِنِ افْتَرَیْتُهٗ فَعَلَیَّ اِجْرَامِیْ وَ اَنَا بَرِیْٓءٌ مِّمَّا تُجْرِمُوْنَ۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: (O Muhammad!) Do they say that he himself has forged this message? Tell them: 'If I have forged this, the guilt of it will fall upon me, but I am not responsible for the crimes you are committing.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اُوْحِیَ اِلٰى نُوْحٍ اَنَّهٗ لَنْ یُّؤْمِنَ مِنْ قَوْمِكَ اِلَّا مَنْ قَدْ اٰمَنَ فَلَا تَبْتَئِسْ بِمَا كَانُوْا یَفْعَلُوْنَۚۖ
ayahs.translation: It was revealed to Noah that no more of your people, other than those who already believe, will ever come to believe. So do not grieve over their deeds,

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اصْنَعِ الْفُلْكَ بِاَعْیُنِنَا وَ وَحْیِنَا وَ لَا تُخَاطِبْنِیْ فِی الَّذِیْنَ ظَلَمُوْا١ۚ اِنَّهُمْ مُّغْرَقُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: and build the Ark under Our eyes and Our direction. And do not supplicate Me concerning those who have engaged in wrong-doing. They are doomed to be drowned.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ یَصْنَعُ الْفُلْكَ١۫ وَ كُلَّمَا مَرَّ عَلَیْهِ مَلَاٌ مِّنْ قَوْمِهٖ سَخِرُوْا مِنْهُ١ؕ قَالَ اِنْ تَسْخَرُوْا مِنَّا فَاِنَّا نَسْخَرُ مِنْكُمْ كَمَا تَسْخَرُوْنَؕ
ayahs.translation: As Noah was building the Ark, whenever the leading men of his nation passed by him, they would scoff at him. He said: 'If you scoff at us, we too scoff at you in like manner.

ayahs.arabicText: فَسَوْفَ تَعْلَمُوْنَ١ۙ مَنْ یَّاْتِیْهِ عَذَابٌ یُّخْزِیْهِ وَ یَحِلُّ عَلَیْهِ عَذَابٌ مُّقِیْمٌ
ayahs.translation: You will come to know who will be struck by a humiliating chastisement, and who will be subjected to an unceasing torment.

ayahs.arabicText: حَتّٰۤى اِذَا جَآءَ اَمْرُنَا وَ فَارَ التَّنُّوْرُ١ۙ قُلْنَا احْمِلْ فِیْهَا مِنْ كُلٍّ زَوْجَیْنِ اثْنَیْنِ وَ اَهْلَكَ اِلَّا مَنْ سَبَقَ عَلَیْهِ الْقَوْلُ وَ مَنْ اٰمَنَ١ؕ وَ مَاۤ اٰمَنَ مَعَهٗۤ اِلَّا قَلِیْلٌ
ayahs.translation: Thus it was until Our command came to pass and the oven boiled over. We said: 'Take into the Ark a pair of every species; and take your own family except those who have already been declared (as unworthy); and also take everyone who believes. But those who, along with him, had believed were indeed just a few.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ قَالَ ارْكَبُوْا فِیْهَا بِسْمِ اللّٰهِ مَجْرٖؔىهَا وَ مُرْسٰىهَا١ؕ اِنَّ رَبِّیْ لَغَفُوْرٌ رَّحِیْمٌ
ayahs.translation: Noah said: ' Embark in it. In the name of Allah is its sailing and its anchorage. My Lord is Ever Forgiving, Most Merciful.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ هِیَ تَجْرِیْ بِهِمْ فِیْ مَوْجٍ كَالْجِبَالِ١۫ وَ نَادٰى نُوْحُ اِ۟بْنَهٗ وَ كَانَ فِیْ مَعْزِلٍ یّٰبُنَیَّ ارْكَبْ مَّعَنَا وَ لَا تَكُنْ مَّعَ الْكٰفِرِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: The Ark sailed along with them amid mountain-like waves. Noah, spotting his son at a distance, called out to him: 'My son. embark with us. and do not be with the unbelievers.'

ayahs.arabicText: قَالَ سَاٰوِیْۤ اِلٰى جَبَلٍ یَّعْصِمُنِیْ مِنَ الْمَآءِ١ؕ قَالَ لَا عَاصِمَ الْیَوْمَ مِنْ اَمْرِ اللّٰهِ اِلَّا مَنْ رَّحِمَ١ۚ وَ حَالَ بَیْنَهُمَا الْمَوْجُ فَكَانَ مِنَ الْمُغْرَقِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: The son replied: 'I will go to a mountain for refuge and it will save me from the water.' Noah said: 'None can save anyone today from the command of Allah except those on whom He may have mercy.' Thereupon a wave swept in between the two and he was drowned.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ قِیْلَ یٰۤاَرْضُ ابْلَعِیْ مَآءَكِ وَ یٰسَمَآءُ اَقْلِعِیْ وَ غِیْضَ الْمَآءُ وَ قُضِیَ الْاَمْرُ وَ اسْتَوَتْ عَلَى الْجُوْدِیِّ وَ قِیْلَ بُعْدًا لِّلْقَوْمِ الظّٰلِمِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: And the command was given: 'Earth! Swallow up your water'; and: 'Heaven! Abate!' So the water subsided, the command was fulfilled, and the Ark settled on Mount Judi, and it was said: 'Away with the wrong-doing folk!'

ayahs.arabicText: وَ نَادٰى نُوْحٌ رَّبَّهٗ فَقَالَ رَبِّ اِنَّ ابْنِیْ مِنْ اَهْلِیْ وَ اِنَّ وَعْدَكَ الْحَقُّ وَ اَنْتَ اَحْكَمُ الْحٰكِمِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: And Noah called out to his Lord, saying: 'My Lord! My son is of my family. Surely Your promise is true, and You are the greatest of those who judge.

ayahs.arabicText: قَالَ یٰنُوْحُ اِنَّهٗ لَیْسَ مِنْ اَهْلِكَ١ۚ اِنَّهٗ عَمَلٌ غَیْرُ صَالِحٍ١ۖ٘ۗ فَلَا تَسْئَلْنِ مَا لَیْسَ لَكَ بِهٖ عِلْمٌ١ؕ اِنِّیْۤ اَعِظُكَ اَنْ تَكُوْنَ مِنَ الْجٰهِلِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: In response Noah was told: 'Most certainly he is not of your family; verily he is of unrighteous conduct. So do not ask of Me for that concerning which you have no knowledge. I admonish you never to act like the ignorant ones.

ayahs.arabicText: قَالَ رَبِّ اِنِّیْۤ اَعُوْذُ بِكَ اَنْ اَسْئَلَكَ مَا لَیْسَ لِیْ بِهٖ عِلْمٌ١ؕ وَ اِلَّا تَغْفِرْ لِیْ وَ تَرْحَمْنِیْۤ اَكُنْ مِّنَ الْخٰسِرِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: Noah said: 'My Lord! I take refuge with You that I should ask you for that concerning which I have no knowledge. And if You do not forgive me and do not show mercy to me, I shall be among the losers.

ayahs.arabicText: قِیْلَ یٰنُوْحُ اهْبِطْ بِسَلٰمٍ مِّنَّا وَ بَرَكٰتٍ عَلَیْكَ وَ عَلٰۤى اُمَمٍ مِّمَّنْ مَّعَكَ١ؕ وَ اُمَمٌ سَنُمَتِّعُهُمْ ثُمَّ یَمَسُّهُمْ مِّنَّا عَذَابٌ اَلِیْمٌ
ayahs.translation: It was said: 'Noah! Disembark, with Our peace, and with blessings upon you and upon those who are with you. There are also people whom We shall allow to enjoy themselves for a while, and then a painful chastisement from Us shall afflict them.'

ayahs.arabicText: تِلْكَ مِنْ اَنْۢبَآءِ الْغَیْبِ نُوْحِیْهَاۤ اِلَیْكَ١ۚ مَا كُنْتَ تَعْلَمُهَاۤ اَنْتَ وَ لَا قَوْمُكَ مِنْ قَبْلِ هٰذَا١ۛؕ فَاصْبِرْ١ۛؕ اِنَّ الْعَاقِبَةَ لِلْمُتَّقِیْنَ۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: We reveal to you these accounts of matters that are beyond the reach of human perception. Neither you nor your people knew about them before this. Be, then, patient. Surely, the good end is for the God-fearing.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اِلٰى عَادٍ اَخَاهُمْ هُوْدًا١ؕ قَالَ یٰقَوْمِ اعْبُدُوا اللّٰهَ مَا لَكُمْ مِّنْ اِلٰهٍ غَیْرُهٗ١ؕ اِنْ اَنْتُمْ اِلَّا مُفْتَرُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: And to 'Ad We sent their brother Hud. He said: 'My people! Serve Allah: you have no god save Him. (In attributing partners to Allah) you have merely been fabricating lies.

ayahs.arabicText: یٰقَوْمِ لَاۤ اَسْئَلُكُمْ عَلَیْهِ اَجْرًا١ؕ اِنْ اَجْرِیَ اِلَّا عَلَى الَّذِیْ فَطَرَنِیْ١ؕ اَفَلَا تَعْقِلُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: My people! I seek no reward from you for my work. My reward lies only with Him Who created me. Do you not understand anything?

ayahs.arabicText: وَ یٰقَوْمِ اسْتَغْفِرُوْا رَبَّكُمْ ثُمَّ تُوْبُوْۤا اِلَیْهِ یُرْسِلِ السَّمَآءَ عَلَیْكُمْ مِّدْرَارًا وَّ یَزِدْكُمْ قُوَّةً اِلٰى قُوَّتِكُمْ وَ لَا تَتَوَلَّوْا مُجْرِمِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: My people! Ask your Lord for forgiveness and turn to Him in repentance. He will shower abundant rains upon you from the heaven, and will add strength to your strength. Do not turn away as those given to guilt.'

ayahs.arabicText: قَالُوْا یٰهُوْدُ مَا جِئْتَنَا بِبَیِّنَةٍ وَّ مَا نَحْنُ بِتَارِكِیْۤ اٰلِهَتِنَا عَنْ قَوْلِكَ وَ مَا نَحْنُ لَكَ بِمُؤْمِنِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: They said: 'O Hud! You have not brought to us any clear evidence, and we are not going to forsake our gods merely because you say so. We are not going to believe you.

ayahs.arabicText: اِنْ نَّقُوْلُ اِلَّا اعْتَرٰىكَ بَعْضُ اٰلِهَتِنَا بِسُوْٓءٍ١ؕ قَالَ اِنِّیْۤ اُشْهِدُ اللّٰهَ وَ اشْهَدُوْۤا اَنِّیْ بَرِیْٓءٌ مِّمَّا تُشْرِكُوْنَۙ
ayahs.translation: All we can say is that some god of ours has afflicted you with evil.. Hud said: 'Indeed I take Allah as my witness, and you too to be my witnesses that I have nothing to do with your associating with Allah

ayahs.arabicText: مِنْ دُوْنِهٖ فَكِیْدُوْنِیْ جَمِیْعًا ثُمَّ لَا تُنْظِرُوْنِ
ayahs.translation: others than Him in His divinity. So conspire against me, all of you, and give me no respite.

ayahs.arabicText: اِنِّیْ تَوَكَّلْتُ عَلَى اللّٰهِ رَبِّیْ وَ رَبِّكُمْ١ؕ مَا مِنْ دَآبَّةٍ اِلَّا هُوَ اٰخِذٌۢ بِنَاصِیَتِهَا١ؕ اِنَّ رَبِّیْ عَلٰى صِرَاطٍ مُّسْتَقِیْمٍ
ayahs.translation: I have put my trust in Allah, Who is my Lord and your Lord. There is no moving creature which He does not hold by its forelock. Surely, My Lord is on the straight path.

ayahs.arabicText: فَاِنْ تَوَلَّوْا فَقَدْ اَبْلَغْتُكُمْ مَّاۤ اُرْسِلْتُ بِهٖۤ اِلَیْكُمْ١ؕ وَ یَسْتَخْلِفُ رَبِّیْ قَوْمًا غَیْرَكُمْ١ۚ وَ لَا تَضُرُّوْنَهٗ شَیْئًا١ؕ اِنَّ رَبِّیْ عَلٰى كُلِّ شَیْءٍ حَفِیْظٌ
ayahs.translation: If you, then, turn away (from the truth), know that I have delivered the message with which I was sent to you. Now my Lord will set up another people in place of you and you shall in no way be able to harm Him. Surely my Lord keeps a watch over everything.'

ayahs.arabicText: وَ لَمَّا جَآءَ اَمْرُنَا نَجَّیْنَا هُوْدًا وَّ الَّذِیْنَ اٰمَنُوْا مَعَهٗ بِرَحْمَةٍ مِّنَّا١ۚ وَ نَجَّیْنٰهُمْ مِّنْ عَذَابٍ غَلِیْظٍ
ayahs.translation: And when Our com-mand came to pass, We delivered Hud, together with those who shared his faith, out of special mercy from Us. We delivered them from a woeful chastisement.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ تِلْكَ عَادٌ١ۙ۫ جَحَدُوْا بِاٰیٰتِ رَبِّهِمْ وَ عَصَوْا رُسُلَهٗ وَ اتَّبَعُوْۤا اَمْرَ كُلِّ جَبَّارٍ عَنِیْدٍ
ayahs.translation: Such were 'Ad. They repudiated the signs of their Lord, disobeyed His Messengers, and followed the bidding of every tyrannical enemy of the truth.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اُتْبِعُوْا فِیْ هٰذِهِ الدُّنْیَا لَعْنَةً وَّ یَوْمَ الْقِیٰمَةِ١ؕ اَلَاۤ اِنَّ عَادًا كَفَرُوْا رَبَّهُمْ١ؕ اَلَا بُعْدًا لِّعَادٍ قَوْمِ هُوْدٍ۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: They were pursued by a curse in this world, and so will they be on the Day of Judgement. Lo! 'Ad disbelieved in the Lord. Lo! ruined are 'Ad, the people of Hud.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اِلٰى ثَمُوْدَ اَخَاهُمْ صٰلِحًا١ۘ قَالَ یٰقَوْمِ اعْبُدُوا اللّٰهَ مَا لَكُمْ مِّنْ اِلٰهٍ غَیْرُهٗ١ؕ هُوَ اَنْشَاَكُمْ مِّنَ الْاَرْضِ وَ اسْتَعْمَرَكُمْ فِیْهَا فَاسْتَغْفِرُوْهُ ثُمَّ تُوْبُوْۤا اِلَیْهِ١ؕ اِنَّ رَبِّیْ قَرِیْبٌ مُّجِیْبٌ
ayahs.translation: And to Thamud We sent their brother Sali'h. He said: 'My people! Serve Allah; you have no god other than Him. He brought you into being out of the earth, and has made you dwell in it. So ask Him to forgive you, and do turn towards Him in repentance. Indeed My Lord is near, responsive to prayers.

ayahs.arabicText: قَالُوْا یٰصٰلِحُ قَدْ كُنْتَ فِیْنَا مَرْجُوًّا قَبْلَ هٰذَاۤ اَتَنْهٰىنَاۤ اَنْ نَّعْبُدَ مَا یَعْبُدُ اٰبَآؤُنَا وَ اِنَّنَا لَفِیْ شَكٍّ مِّمَّا تَدْعُوْنَاۤ اِلَیْهِ مُرِیْبٍ
ayahs.translation: They said: 'O Salih! Until now you were one of those among us on whom we placed great hopes. Now, would you forbid us to worship what our forefathers were wont to worship? Indeed we are in disquieting doubt about what you are calling us to.

ayahs.arabicText: قَالَ یٰقَوْمِ اَرَءَیْتُمْ اِنْ كُنْتُ عَلٰى بَیِّنَةٍ مِّنْ رَّبِّیْ وَ اٰتٰىنِیْ مِنْهُ رَحْمَةً فَمَنْ یَّنْصُرُنِیْ مِنَ اللّٰهِ اِنْ عَصَیْتُهٗ١۫ فَمَا تَزِیْدُوْنَنِیْ غَیْرَ تَخْسِیْرٍ
ayahs.translation: Salih said: 'My people! What do you think? If I had a clear evidence from my Lord, and then He also bestowed His mercy upon me, who will rescue me from the punishment of Allah if I still disobey Him? You can only make me lose even more.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ یٰقَوْمِ هٰذِهٖ نَاقَةُ اللّٰهِ لَكُمْ اٰیَةً فَذَرُوْهَا تَاْكُلْ فِیْۤ اَرْضِ اللّٰهِ وَ لَا تَمَسُّوْهَا بِسُوْٓءٍ فَیَاْخُذَكُمْ عَذَابٌ قَرِیْبٌ
ayahs.translation: My people! This she-camel of Allah is a sign for you. So let her pasture on Allah's earth, and do not hurt her or else some chastisement - which is near at hand -should overtake you.'

ayahs.arabicText: فَعَقَرُوْهَا فَقَالَ تَمَتَّعُوْا فِیْ دَارِكُمْ ثَلٰثَةَ اَیَّامٍ١ؕ ذٰلِكَ وَعْدٌ غَیْرُ مَكْذُوْبٍ
ayahs.translation: But they slaughtered her. Thereupon Salih warned them: 'Enjoy yourselves in your homes for a maximum of three days. This is a promise which shall not be belied.'

ayahs.arabicText: فَلَمَّا جَآءَ اَمْرُنَا نَجَّیْنَا صٰلِحًا وَّ الَّذِیْنَ اٰمَنُوْا مَعَهٗ بِرَحْمَةٍ مِّنَّا وَ مِنْ خِزْیِ یَوْمِئِذٍ١ؕ اِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ الْقَوِیُّ الْعَزِیْزُ
ayahs.translation: Then, when Our command came to pass, We saved Salih and those who shared his faith through Our special mercy, from the disgrace of that day. Truly Your Lord is All-Strong, All-Mighty.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اَخَذَ الَّذِیْنَ ظَلَمُوا الصَّیْحَةُ فَاَصْبَحُوْا فِیْ دِیَارِهِمْ جٰثِمِیْنَۙ
ayahs.translation: And the Blast overtook those who were wont to do wrong, and then they lay lifeless in their homes

ayahs.arabicText: كَاَنْ لَّمْ یَغْنَوْا فِیْهَا١ؕ اَلَاۤ اِنَّ ثَمُوْدَاۡ كَفَرُوْا رَبَّهُمْ١ؕ اَلَا بُعْدًا لِّثَمُوْدَ۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: as though they had never lived there before. Oh, verily the Thamud denied their Lord! Oh, the Thamud were destroyed.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ لَقَدْ جَآءَتْ رُسُلُنَاۤ اِبْرٰهِیْمَ بِالْبُشْرٰى قَالُوْا سَلٰمًا١ؕ قَالَ سَلٰمٌ فَمَا لَبِثَ اَنْ جَآءَ بِعِجْلٍ حَنِیْذٍ
ayahs.translation: Indeed Our messengers came to Abraham, bearing glad tidings. They greeted him with 'peace', and Abraham answered back to them 'peace', and hurriedly brought to them a roasted calf.

ayahs.arabicText: فَلَمَّا رَاٰۤ اَیْدِیَهُمْ لَا تَصِلُ اِلَیْهِ نَكِرَهُمْ وَ اَوْجَسَ مِنْهُمْ خِیْفَةً١ؕ قَالُوْا لَا تَخَفْ اِنَّاۤ اُرْسِلْنَاۤ اِلٰى قَوْمِ لُوْطٍؕ
ayahs.translation: When he perceived that their hands could not reach it, he mistrusted them, and felt afraid of them. They said: 'Do not be afraid. We have been sent to the people of Lot.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ امْرَاَتُهٗ قَآئِمَةٌ فَضَحِكَتْ فَبَشَّرْنٰهَا بِاِسْحٰقَ١ۙ وَ مِنْ وَّرَآءِ اِسْحٰقَ یَعْقُوْبَ
ayahs.translation: And Abraham's wife was standing by and on hearing this she laughed. And We gave her the good news of (the birth of) Isaac, and after Isaac, of Jacob.

ayahs.arabicText: قَالَتْ یٰوَیْلَتٰۤى ءَاَلِدُ وَ اَنَا عَجُوْزٌ وَّ هٰذَا بَعْلِیْ شَیْخًا١ؕ اِنَّ هٰذَا لَشَیْءٌ عَجِیْبٌ
ayahs.translation: She said: 'Woe is me! Shall I bear a child now that I am an old woman and my husband is well advanced in years. This is indeed strange!'

ayahs.arabicText: قَالُوْۤا اَتَعْجَبِیْنَ مِنْ اَمْرِ اللّٰهِ رَحْمَتُ اللّٰهِ وَ بَرَكٰتُهٗ عَلَیْكُمْ اَهْلَ الْبَیْتِ١ؕ اِنَّهٗ حَمِیْدٌ مَّجِیْدٌ
ayahs.translation: They said: 'Do you wonder at Allah's decree? Allah's mercy and His blessings be upon you, O people of the house. Surely, He is Praiseworthy, Glorious.'

ayahs.arabicText: فَلَمَّا ذَهَبَ عَنْ اِبْرٰهِیْمَ الرَّوْعُ وَ جَآءَتْهُ الْبُشْرٰى یُجَادِلُنَا فِیْ قَوْمِ لُوْطٍؕ
ayahs.translation: Thus when fear had left Abraham and the good news had been conveyed to him, he began to dispute with Us concerning the people of Lot.

ayahs.arabicText: اِنَّ اِبْرٰهِیْمَ لَحَلِیْمٌ اَوَّاهٌ مُّنِیْبٌ
ayahs.translation: Surely Abraham was forbearing, tenderhearted and oft-turning to Allah.

ayahs.arabicText: یٰۤاِبْرٰهِیْمُ اَعْرِضْ عَنْ هٰذَا١ۚ اِنَّهٗ قَدْ جَآءَ اَمْرُ رَبِّكَ١ۚ وَ اِنَّهُمْ اٰتِیْهِمْ عَذَابٌ غَیْرُ مَرْدُوْدٍ
ayahs.translation: Thereupon (Our angels) said to him: 'O Abraham! Desist from this, for indeed your Lord's command has come; and a chastisement which cannot be averted is about to befall them.' words literally suggest; the purpose is merely to express a sense of wonder.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ لَمَّا جَآءَتْ رُسُلُنَا لُوْطًا سِیْٓءَ بِهِمْ وَ ضَاقَ بِهِمْ ذَرْعًا وَّ قَالَ هٰذَا یَوْمٌ عَصِیْبٌ
ayahs.translation: And when Our messengers came to Lot, he was perturbed by their coming and felt troubled on their account, and said: 'This is a distressing day.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ جَآءَهٗ قَوْمُهٗ یُهْرَعُوْنَ اِلَیْهِ١ؕ وَ مِنْ قَبْلُ كَانُوْا یَعْمَلُوْنَ السَّیِّاٰتِ١ؕ قَالَ یٰقَوْمِ هٰۤؤُلَآءِ بَنَاتِیْ هُنَّ اَطْهَرُ لَكُمْ فَاتَّقُوا اللّٰهَ وَ لَا تُخْزُوْنِ فِیْ ضَیْفِیْ١ؕ اَلَیْسَ مِنْكُمْ رَجُلٌ رَّشِیْدٌ
ayahs.translation: And his people came to him rushing. Before this they were wont to commit evil deeds. Lot said: 'My people! Here are my daughters; they are purer for you. Have fear of Allah and do not disgrace me concerning my guests. Is there not even one right-minded person in your midst?'

ayahs.arabicText: قَالُوْا لَقَدْ عَلِمْتَ مَا لَنَا فِیْ بَنٰتِكَ مِنْ حَقٍّ١ۚ وَ اِنَّكَ لَتَعْلَمُ مَا نُرِیْدُ
ayahs.translation: They said: 'Surely you already know that we have nothing to do with your daughters. You also know well what we want.'

ayahs.arabicText: قَالَ لَوْ اَنَّ لِیْ بِكُمْ قُوَّةً اَوْ اٰوِیْۤ اِلٰى رُكْنٍ شَدِیْدٍ
ayahs.translation: He said: 'Would that I had the strength to set you straight, or could seek refuge in some powerful support.'

ayahs.arabicText: قَالُوْا یٰلُوْطُ اِنَّا رُسُلُ رَبِّكَ لَنْ یَّصِلُوْۤا اِلَیْكَ فَاَسْرِ بِاَهْلِكَ بِقِطْعٍ مِّنَ الَّیْلِ وَ لَا یَلْتَفِتْ مِنْكُمْ اَحَدٌ اِلَّا امْرَاَتَكَ١ؕ اِنَّهٗ مُصِیْبُهَا مَاۤ اَصَابَهُمْ١ؕ اِنَّ مَوْعِدَهُمُ الصُّبْحُ١ؕ اَلَیْسَ الصُّبْحُ بِقَرِیْبٍ
ayahs.translation: Thereupon the angels said: 'O Lot! We indeed are messengers of your Lord. And your people will in no way be able to hurt you. So depart with your family in a part of the night and let no one of you turn around excepting your wife (who shall not go); for what will befall them shall also befall her. In the morning their promised hour will come. Is not the morning near?'

ayahs.arabicText: فَلَمَّا جَآءَ اَمْرُنَا جَعَلْنَا عَالِیَهَا سَافِلَهَا وَ اَمْطَرْنَا عَلَیْهَا حِجَارَةً مِّنْ سِجِّیْلٍ١ۙ۬ مَّنْضُوْدٍۙ
ayahs.translation: And when Our command came to pass, We turned the town upside down, and rained on it stones of baked clay, one on another,

ayahs.arabicText: مُّسَوَّمَةً عِنْدَ رَبِّكَ١ؕ وَ مَا هِیَ مِنَ الظّٰلِمِیْنَ بِبَعِیْدٍ۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: marked from your Lord. Nor is the punishment far off from the wrong-doers.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اِلٰى مَدْیَنَ اَخَاهُمْ شُعَیْبًا١ؕ قَالَ یٰقَوْمِ اعْبُدُوا اللّٰهَ مَا لَكُمْ مِّنْ اِلٰهٍ غَیْرُهٗ١ؕ وَ لَا تَنْقُصُوا الْمِكْیَالَ وَ الْمِیْزَانَ اِنِّیْۤ اَرٰىكُمْ بِخَیْرٍ وَّ اِنِّیْۤ اَخَافُ عَلَیْكُمْ عَذَابَ یَوْمٍ مُّحِیْطٍ
ayahs.translation: And to (the people of) Midian We sent their brother Shu'ayb. He said: 'My people! Serve Allah; you have no god other than Him. And do not diminish the measure and weight. Indeed I see that you are prospering now, but I fear for you the chastisement of an encompassing day in the future.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ یٰقَوْمِ اَوْفُوا الْمِكْیَالَ وَ الْمِیْزَانَ بِالْقِسْطِ وَ لَا تَبْخَسُوا النَّاسَ اَشْیَآءَهُمْ وَ لَا تَعْثَوْا فِی الْاَرْضِ مُفْسِدِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: My people! Give full measure and weight with justice, do not diminish the goods of others, and do not go about creating corruption in the land.

ayahs.arabicText: بَقِیَّتُ اللّٰهِ خَیْرٌ لَّكُمْ اِنْ كُنْتُمْ مُّؤْمِنِیْنَ١ۚ۬ وَ مَاۤ اَنَا عَلَیْكُمْ بِحَفِیْظٍ
ayahs.translation: The gains that Allah lets you retain are better for you, if you indeed believe. In any case, I have not been appointed a keeper over you.

ayahs.arabicText: قَالُوْا یٰشُعَیْبُ اَصَلٰوتُكَ تَاْمُرُكَ اَنْ نَّتْرُكَ مَا یَعْبُدُ اٰبَآؤُنَاۤ اَوْ اَنْ نَّفْعَلَ فِیْۤ اَمْوَالِنَا مَا نَشٰٓؤُا١ؕ اِنَّكَ لَاَنْتَ الْحَلِیْمُ الرَّشِیْدُ
ayahs.translation: They replied: 'O Shu'ayb! Does your Prayer enjoin upon you that we should forsake the deities whom our forefathers worshipped, or that we should give up using our wealth as we please? Do you fancy that you, and only you, are forbearing and right-directed?'

ayahs.arabicText: قَالَ یٰقَوْمِ اَرَءَیْتُمْ اِنْ كُنْتُ عَلٰى بَیِّنَةٍ مِّنْ رَّبِّیْ وَ رَزَقَنِیْ مِنْهُ رِزْقًا حَسَنًا١ؕ وَ مَاۤ اُرِیْدُ اَنْ اُخَالِفَكُمْ اِلٰى مَاۤ اَنْهٰىكُمْ عَنْهُ١ؕ اِنْ اُرِیْدُ اِلَّا الْاِصْلَاحَ مَا اسْتَطَعْتُ١ؕ وَ مَا تَوْفِیْقِیْۤ اِلَّا بِاللّٰهِ١ؕ عَلَیْهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ وَ اِلَیْهِ اُنِیْبُ
ayahs.translation: Shu'ayb said: 'My people! What do you think? If I stand on clear evidence from my Lord, and He has also provided me a handsome provision from Himself -(should I be ungrateful to Him and share your error and iniquity?) Nor do I desire to act contrary to what I admonish you. I desire nothing but to set things right as far as I can. My succour is only with Allah. In Him have I put my trust, and to Him do I always turn.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ یٰقَوْمِ لَا یَجْرِمَنَّكُمْ شِقَاقِیْۤ اَنْ یُّصِیْبَكُمْ مِّثْلُ مَاۤ اَصَابَ قَوْمَ نُوْحٍ اَوْ قَوْمَ هُوْدٍ اَوْ قَوْمَ صٰلِحٍ١ؕ وَ مَا قَوْمُ لُوْطٍ مِّنْكُمْ بِبَعِیْدٍ
ayahs.translation: My people! Let not your opposition to me lead you to guilt that would bring upon you the chastisement that struck earlier the people of Noah, and the people of Hud, and the people of Salih. And the land of the people of Lot is not far from you!

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اسْتَغْفِرُوْا رَبَّكُمْ ثُمَّ تُوْبُوْۤا اِلَیْهِ١ؕ اِنَّ رَبِّیْ رَحِیْمٌ وَّدُوْدٌ
ayahs.translation: Seek the forgiveness of your Lord and turn to Him in repentance. Surely my Lord is Ever Merciful, Most Loving.

ayahs.arabicText: قَالُوْا یٰشُعَیْبُ مَا نَفْقَهُ كَثِیْرًا مِّمَّا تَقُوْلُ وَ اِنَّا لَنَرٰىكَ فِیْنَا ضَعِیْفًا١ۚ وَ لَوْ لَا رَهْطُكَ لَرَجَمْنٰكَ١٘ وَ مَاۤ اَنْتَ عَلَیْنَا بِعَزِیْزٍ
ayahs.translation: They said: 'O Shu'ayb! We do not understand much of what you say. Indeed we see you weak in our midst. Were it not for your kinsmen, we would surely have stoned you for you have no strength to overpower us.

ayahs.arabicText: قَالَ یٰقَوْمِ اَرَهْطِیْۤ اَعَزُّ عَلَیْكُمْ مِّنَ اللّٰهِ١ؕ وَ اتَّخَذْتُمُوْهُ وَرَآءَكُمْ ظِهْرِیًّا١ؕ اِنَّ رَبِّیْ بِمَا تَعْمَلُوْنَ مُحِیْطٌ
ayahs.translation: Shu'ayb said: 'My people! Are my kinsmen mightier with you than Allah that you (hold the kinsmen in awe while) you cast Allah behind your back? Surely my Lord encompasses all what you do.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ یٰقَوْمِ اعْمَلُوْا عَلٰى مَكَانَتِكُمْ اِنِّیْ عَامِلٌ١ؕ سَوْفَ تَعْلَمُوْنَ١ۙ مَنْ یَّاْتِیْهِ عَذَابٌ یُّخْزِیْهِ وَ مَنْ هُوَ كَاذِبٌ١ؕ وَ ارْتَقِبُوْۤا اِنِّیْ مَعَكُمْ رَقِیْبٌ
ayahs.translation: My people! Go on working according to your way and I will keep working (according to mine). Soon you will come to know who will be afflicted by a humiliating chastisement, and who is proved a liar. And watch, I shall also watch with you.'

ayahs.arabicText: وَ لَمَّا جَآءَ اَمْرُنَا نَجَّیْنَا شُعَیْبًا وَّ الَّذِیْنَ اٰمَنُوْا مَعَهٗ بِرَحْمَةٍ مِّنَّا وَ اَخَذَتِ الَّذِیْنَ ظَلَمُوا الصَّیْحَةُ فَاَصْبَحُوْا فِیْ دِیَارِهِمْ جٰثِمِیْنَۙ
ayahs.translation: And when Our command came to pass, We delivered Shu'ayb and those who shared his faith, through Our mercy, and the Blast seized those who were engaged in wrong-doing, so they lay lifeless in their homes

ayahs.arabicText: كَاَنْ لَّمْ یَغْنَوْا فِیْهَا١ؕ اَلَا بُعْدًا لِّمَدْیَنَ كَمَا بَعِدَتْ ثَمُوْدُ۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: as though they had never dwelt in them before. Lo! Away with (the people of) Midian, even as the Thamud were done away with!

ayahs.arabicText: وَ لَقَدْ اَرْسَلْنَا مُوْسٰى بِاٰیٰتِنَا وَ سُلْطٰنٍ مُّبِیْنٍۙ
ayahs.translation: And indeed We sent Moses with Our signs and with a clear authority

ayahs.arabicText: اِلٰى فِرْعَوْنَ وَ مَلَاۡئِهٖ فَاتَّبَعُوْۤا اَمْرَ فِرْعَوْنَ١ۚ وَ مَاۤ اَمْرُ فِرْعَوْنَ بِرَشِیْدٍ
ayahs.translation: to Pharaoh and his nobles. But they obeyed the command of Pharaoh even though Pharaoh's command was not rightly-directed.

ayahs.arabicText: یَقْدُمُ قَوْمَهٗ یَوْمَ الْقِیٰمَةِ فَاَوْرَدَهُمُ النَّارَ١ؕ وَ بِئْسَ الْوِرْدُ الْمَوْرُوْدُ
ayahs.translation: He shall stand at the head of his people on the Day of Resurrection, and will bring them down to the Fire. What a wretched destination to be led to!

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اُتْبِعُوْا فِیْ هٰذِهٖ لَعْنَةً وَّ یَوْمَ الْقِیٰمَةِ١ؕ بِئْسَ الرِّفْدُ الْمَرْفُوْدُ
ayahs.translation: They were pursued by a curse in this world and so will they be on the Day of Resurrection. What an evil reward will they receive!

ayahs.arabicText: ذٰلِكَ مِنْ اَنْۢبَآءِ الْقُرٰى نَقُصُّهٗ عَلَیْكَ مِنْهَا قَآئِمٌ وَّ حَصِیْدٌ
ayahs.translation: That is an account of some towns which We recount to you. Of them some are still standing and some have been mown down.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ مَا ظَلَمْنٰهُمْ وَ لٰكِنْ ظَلَمُوْۤا اَنْفُسَهُمْ فَمَاۤ اَغْنَتْ عَنْهُمْ اٰلِهَتُهُمُ الَّتِیْ یَدْعُوْنَ مِنْ دُوْنِ اللّٰهِ مِنْ شَیْءٍ لَّمَّا جَآءَ اَمْرُ رَبِّكَ١ؕ وَ مَا زَادُوْهُمْ غَیْرَ تَتْبِیْبٍ
ayahs.translation: We did not wrong them; it is rather they who wronged themselves. And when the command of your Lord came to pass, the gods besides Allah whom they had called upon, did not avail them in the least. They added nothing to them except ruin.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ كَذٰلِكَ اَخْذُ رَبِّكَ اِذَاۤ اَخَذَ الْقُرٰى وَ هِیَ ظَالِمَةٌ١ؕ اِنَّ اَخْذَهٗۤ اَلِیْمٌ شَدِیْدٌ
ayahs.translation: Such is the seizing of your Lord that when He does seize the towns immersed in wrong-doing, His seizing is painful, terrible.

ayahs.arabicText: اِنَّ فِیْ ذٰلِكَ لَاٰیَةً لِّمَنْ خَافَ عَذَابَ الْاٰخِرَةِ١ؕ ذٰلِكَ یَوْمٌ مَّجْمُوْعٌ١ۙ لَّهُ النَّاسُ وَ ذٰلِكَ یَوْمٌ مَّشْهُوْدٌ
ayahs.translation: Surely in that is a sign for him who fears the chastisement of the Hereafter. That will be a Day when all men shall be mustered together; that will be a Day when whatever happens shall be witnessed by all.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ مَا نُؤَخِّرُهٗۤ اِلَّا لِاَجَلٍ مَّعْدُوْدٍؕ
ayahs.translation: Nor shall We withhold it except till an appointed term.

ayahs.arabicText: یَوْمَ یَاْتِ لَا تَكَلَّمُ نَفْسٌ اِلَّا بِاِذْنِهٖ١ۚ فَمِنْهُمْ شَقِیٌّ وَّ سَعِیْدٌ
ayahs.translation: And when the appointed Day comes, no one shall even dare to speak except by the leave of Allah. Then some will be declared wretched, others blessed.

ayahs.arabicText: فَاَمَّا الَّذِیْنَ شَقُوْا فَفِی النَّارِ لَهُمْ فِیْهَا زَفِیْرٌ وَّ شَهِیْقٌۙ
ayahs.translation: As for the wretched, they shall be in the Fire, and in it they shall sigh and groan.

ayahs.arabicText: خٰلِدِیْنَ فِیْهَا مَا دَامَتِ السَّمٰوٰتُ وَ الْاَرْضُ اِلَّا مَا شَآءَ رَبُّكَ١ؕ اِنَّ رَبَّكَ فَعَّالٌ لِّمَا یُرِیْدُ
ayahs.translation: They shall abide in it as long as the heavens and the earth endure, unless your Lord may will otherwise. Surely your Lord does whatsoever He wills.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اَمَّا الَّذِیْنَ سُعِدُوْا فَفِی الْجَنَّةِ خٰلِدِیْنَ فِیْهَا مَا دَامَتِ السَّمٰوٰتُ وَ الْاَرْضُ اِلَّا مَا شَآءَ رَبُّكَ١ؕ عَطَآءً غَیْرَ مَجْذُوْذٍ
ayahs.translation: And as for those who are blessed, they shall abide in the Garden as long as the heavens and the earth endure, unless your Lord may will otherwise. They shall enjoy an unceasing gift.

ayahs.arabicText: فَلَا تَكُ فِیْ مِرْیَةٍ مِّمَّا یَعْبُدُ هٰۤؤُلَآءِ١ؕ مَا یَعْبُدُوْنَ اِلَّا كَمَا یَعْبُدُ اٰبَآؤُهُمْ مِّنْ قَبْلُ١ؕ وَ اِنَّا لَمُوَفُّوْهُمْ نَصِیْبَهُمْ غَیْرَ مَنْقُوْصٍ۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: [O Prophet!] Have no doubt about what they worship. For they worship what their fathers worshipped before. And (yet) We shall grant them their due portion in full, diminishing of it nothing.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ لَقَدْ اٰتَیْنَا مُوْسَى الْكِتٰبَ فَاخْتُلِفَ فِیْهِ١ؕ وَ لَوْ لَا كَلِمَةٌ سَبَقَتْ مِنْ رَّبِّكَ لَقُضِیَ بَیْنَهُمْ١ؕ وَ اِنَّهُمْ لَفِیْ شَكٍّ مِّنْهُ مُرِیْبٍ
ayahs.translation: And We certainly gave Moses the Book before, and there arose disagreements about it (even as there are disagreements now about the Book revealed to you). Had it not been for a decree that had already gone forth from your Lord, the matter would have long been decided between them. Indeed they are in a disquieting doubt about it.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اِنَّ كُلًّا لَّمَّا لَیُوَفِّیَنَّهُمْ رَبُّكَ اَعْمَالَهُمْ١ؕ اِنَّهٗ بِمَا یَعْمَلُوْنَ خَبِیْرٌ
ayahs.translation: Surely your Lord will recompense all to the full for their deeds. For indeed He is well aware of all what they do.

ayahs.arabicText: فَاسْتَقِمْ كَمَاۤ اُمِرْتَ وَ مَنْ تَابَ مَعَكَ وَ لَا تَطْغَوْا١ؕ اِنَّهٗ بِمَا تَعْمَلُوْنَ بَصِیْرٌ
ayahs.translation: So remain, (O Muhammad), you and those who have returned with you (to the fold of faith and obedience from unbelief and rebellion) steadfast (in adhering to the straight way) as you were commanded. And do not exceed the limits of (service to Allah). For certainly He is aware of all what you do.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ لَا تَرْكَنُوْۤا اِلَى الَّذِیْنَ ظَلَمُوْا فَتَمَسَّكُمُ النَّارُ١ۙ وَ مَا لَكُمْ مِّنْ دُوْنِ اللّٰهِ مِنْ اَوْلِیَآءَ ثُمَّ لَا تُنْصَرُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: And do not incline towards the wrong-doers lest the Fire might seize you and you will have none as your protector against Allah; and then you will not be helped from anywhere.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اَقِمِ الصَّلٰوةَ طَرَفَیِ النَّهَارِ وَ زُلَفًا مِّنَ الَّیْلِ١ؕ اِنَّ الْحَسَنٰتِ یُذْهِبْنَ السَّیِّاٰتِ١ؕ ذٰلِكَ ذِكْرٰى لِلذّٰكِرِیْنَۚ
ayahs.translation: And establish the Prayer at the two ends of the day and in the first hours of the night. Indeed the good deeds drive away the evil deeds. This is a Reminder to those who are mindful of Allah.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اصْبِرْ فَاِنَّ اللّٰهَ لَا یُضِیْعُ اَجْرَ الْمُحْسِنِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: And be patient; for indeed Allah never lets the reward of those who do good go to waste.

ayahs.arabicText: فَلَوْ لَا كَانَ مِنَ الْقُرُوْنِ مِنْ قَبْلِكُمْ اُولُوْا بَقِیَّةٍ یَّنْهَوْنَ عَنِ الْفَسَادِ فِی الْاَرْضِ اِلَّا قَلِیْلًا مِّمَّنْ اَنْجَیْنَا مِنْهُمْ١ۚ وَ اتَّبَعَ الَّذِیْنَ ظَلَمُوْا مَاۤ اُتْرِفُوْا فِیْهِ وَ كَانُوْا مُجْرِمِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: Why were there not, out of the generations that passed away before you, righteous men who would forbid others from causing corruption on the earth? And if such were there, they were only a few whom We had saved from those generations, or else the wrong-doers kept pursuing the ease and comfort which had been conferred upon them, thus losing themselves in sinfulness.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ مَا كَانَ رَبُّكَ لِیُهْلِكَ الْقُرٰى بِظُلْمٍ وَّ اَهْلُهَا مُصْلِحُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: And your Lord is not such as would wrongfully destroy human habitations while their inhabitants are righteous.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ لَوْ شَآءَ رَبُّكَ لَجَعَلَ النَّاسَ اُمَّةً وَّاحِدَةً وَّ لَا یَزَالُوْنَ مُخْتَلِفِیْنَۙ
ayahs.translation: Had your Lord so willed, He would surely have made mankind one community. But as things stand, now they will not cease to differ among themselves and to follow erroneous ways

ayahs.arabicText: اِلَّا مَنْ رَّحِمَ رَبُّكَ١ؕ وَ لِذٰلِكَ خَلَقَهُمْ١ؕ وَ تَمَّتْ كَلِمَةُ رَبِّكَ لَاَمْلَئَنَّ جَهَنَّمَ مِنَ الْجِنَّةِ وَ النَّاسِ اَجْمَعِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: except for those on whom your Lord has mercy. And it is for this (exercise of freedom of choice) that He has created them. And the word of your Lord was fulfilled: 'Indeed I will fill the Hell, with men and jinn, altogether.'

ayahs.arabicText: وَ كُلًّا نَّقُصُّ عَلَیْكَ مِنْ اَنْۢبَآءِ الرُّسُلِ مَا نُثَبِّتُ بِهٖ فُؤَادَكَ١ۚ وَ جَآءَكَ فِیْ هٰذِهِ الْحَقُّ وَ مَوْعِظَةٌ وَّ ذِكْرٰى لِلْمُؤْمِنِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: (O Muhammad!) We narrate these anecdotes of Messengers to you that We may strengthen through them your heart. In these anecdotes come to you the truth, and an exhortation, and a reminder for the believers.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ قُلْ لِّلَّذِیْنَ لَا یُؤْمِنُوْنَ اعْمَلُوْا عَلٰى مَكَانَتِكُمْ١ؕ اِنَّا عٰمِلُوْنَۙ
ayahs.translation: As for those who are bent on not believing, tell them: 'Work according to your way and we are working according to our way.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ انْتَظِرُوْا١ۚ اِنَّا مُنْتَظِرُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: And do wait for the end of things; we too are waiting.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ لِلّٰهِ غَیْبُ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَ الْاَرْضِ وَ اِلَیْهِ یُرْجَعُ الْاَمْرُ كُلُّهٗ فَاعْبُدْهُ وَ تَوَكَّلْ عَلَیْهِ١ؕ وَ مَا رَبُّكَ بِغَافِلٍ عَمَّا تَعْمَلُوْنَ۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: All that is hidden in the heavens and the earth lies within the power of Allah. To Him are all matters referred for judgement. So do serve Him, and place in Him all your trust. Your Lord is not heedless of what you do.
